validation.grafana_publication: Authenticated import overwrite of the same UID; final values and graphs verified in UI
validation.visual_check: Overview, resources, disk/network and API/telemetry displayed live data; free byte cards use neutral blue

observations: Initial live query checks exposed load/vCPU label matching; fixed with on(instance), then all 85 checks returned data.
Initial visual check exposed Grafana default red thresholds on free byte cards; corrected and reimported.
Final overview screenshot showed approximately 9% CPU, 46% RAM and 44% root disk used, 27.4 GiB disk available, 0% recent API 5xx and 5 ms recent P95.
HTTP 5xx occurred earlier in the observed interval; low current resource use does not prove every application function is healthy.
scope_and_limits: Host resources include neighboring processes; HTTP metrics belong to BOOHTACORD.
Availability means node-exporter scrape success; telemetry target health covers three telemetry components only.
Missing measurements are not substituted with healthy zeroes. Node resource gauges are gated on exporter availability.
No production container, LiveKit or PostgreSQL exporter series were available; unrelated database metrics were not substituted.
Thresholds are attention guides, not validated capacity limits. UDP host errors are not viewer WebRTC loss.
No application restart, new datasource, exporter, public port or credential change was required.
